event_summary: Completed JPMC Senior Lead Software Engineer application. Overhauled resume tailoring strategy to maintain dual-identity (Leadership metrics + AI tooling) without truncating older history. Strict 2-page margin boundaries implemented for PDF generation.
learned_rules: Never truncate important data points or work experience descriptions during tailoring.
Resume must balance leadership metrics with targeted skills rather than replacing one with another.
Always update resume.md and strategic documentation (STRATEGIC_RESUME_TAILORING.md, COMPANY_ATS_KNOWLEDGE.md) before applying.
action_taken: Updated resume.md, generated 2-page PDF, completed JPMC attachment upload. Created docs/STRATEGIC_RESUME_TAILORING.md and updated WORKSPACE_RULES.md with Rule 14. Extracted JPMC prompt into clean standalone.
